verdict.rationale: AgentMail is a hosted email API, so self-hosting is a fair question for it. The only relevant evidence is a community report that its enterprise options include "Bring Your Own Cloud," which would let a customer run the mail pipeline in their own cloud. Open-source SDKs and custom domains are adjacent features and do not count as self-hosting. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the BYOC/self-hosted deployment, availability outside enterprise plans, details on which pipeline components (MTA, storage, delivery) run under customer control, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control

citations.quote: the enterprise options include Bring Your Own Cloud
the Bring Your Own Cloud enterprise option makes things much easier for them
